en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3808 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abi Walad, from Abu Abdullah (as), and others from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as):
"There is no harm in paying a broker's fee. He only buys for people day after day for a specified amount. He is just like a hired worker."
